lead_headline: Restaurant tracker hits 16-day freeze—no leads detected across metro Denver since May 25 as unprecedented June drought continues

restaurant.blurb: No leads detected today—tracker's June paralysis now spans 16 consecutive days, matching longest documented drought as detection apparatus remains completely silent across all metro neighborhoods.
